us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump returns to the UN amid wars, AI anxiety and questions over US support
bullets: Trump is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Tuesday.
The White House says he also plans meetings with UK, Japanese and Gulf leaders.
Iran, AI and the future of the UN are central themes around the visit.

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue White House after access ban
bullets: The outlets sued after being barred from White House access.
Major TV networks canceled pool coverage in response to CNN being blocked from its assigned duty.
The dispute has become a First Amendment fight over presidential press access.

articles.title: Appeals panel favors Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
bullets: A federal appeals panel ruled for Missouri districts backed by Trump.
The Supreme Court has blocked those districts from being used in November for now.
Republicans say the revised map could help them win seven of Missouri’s eight House seats.

articles.title: Kamala Harris campaigns for Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan Senate race
bullets: Harris is campaigning Tuesday in Detroit with Democrat Abdul El-Sayed.
The events include a Black maternal health roundtable and a Detroit NAACP appearance.
Michigan is a key Senate battleground for control of the chamber.

articles.title: Energy Department selects $99 million in geothermal projects
bullets: DOE announced more than $99 million for 21 geothermal projects.
The funding targets enhanced geothermal systems tests and exploration drilling.
Project data will be made public through DOE’s Geothermal Data Repository.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine trade deadly strikes before Zelenskyy-Trump meeting
bullets: Russian strikes hit at least four Ukrainian regions overnight, killing five people, officials said.
Ukraine said it damaged another Russian oil refinery in a long-range strike.
Zelenskyy is in the US for UN meetings and is expected to meet Trump.

articles.title: World leaders gather at UN with wars and instability dominating agenda
bullets: The UN General Assembly opens amid escalating conflicts in Europe and the Middle East.
Officials cited wars, climate shocks, public health risks and AI as major concerns.
Diplomats hope sidelines talks can address Hormuz security and conflict mediation.

articles.title: North Korea touts new missile system described as hypersonic
bullets: North Korea said its latest missile tests involved a new weapons system of major significance.
Photos indicated a missile previously described as hypersonic was launched.
South Korea said two short-range missiles flew toward the sea from Wonsan.

articles.title: South Korea’s Lee urges step-by-step path on North Korea’s nuclear program
bullets: President Lee Jae Myung told AP he wants a phased approach to North Korea’s nuclear dismantlement.
The push comes as North Korea refuses dialogue and continues missile activity.
Lee is seeking a way to restart diplomacy while managing regional security risks.

articles.title: Mideast wars loom over UN as Gulf states press Iran over attacks
bullets: Middle East conflicts are high on the UN agenda this week.
The Gulf Cooperation Council called on Iran and allied groups to stop attacks on Gulf states.
Trump is set to meet Gulf Arab leaders as the US-Iran conflict continues.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Three infants die after fire at Telangana hospital neonatal unit
bullets: A fire broke out at the SNCU of RIMS Government Hospital in Adilabad late Monday.
Three infants died, while dozens of babies were evacuated.
Officials said the exact cause is under investigation.

articles.title: IIT Bombay suspends dean after student death sparks protests
bullets: IIT Bombay suspended Prof. Suryanarayana Doolla from his deanship amid protests.
The institute apologized for its initial statement and promised a review of exam rules.
The case followed the death by suicide of a second-year BTech student.

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA to take effect on October 20
bullets: Piyush Goyal said the free trade agreement will come into force on October 20, 2026.
The pact gives duty-free access to 100% of India’s exports to New Zealand.
Both countries aim to double goods and services trade to about NZ$7 billion by 2030.

articles.title: J&K headmaster terminated after minor’s death in failed abortion case
bullets: The J&K government dismissed a school headmaster accused of abusing a minor tribal girl.
Officials said the teacher was already suspended and in judicial custody.
The girl died in August after an alleged failed abortion attempt.

articles.title: Centre doubles environmental clearance validity for ports to 20 years
bullets: India amended EIA rules to extend port and harbour environmental clearances to at least 20 years.
Two additional five-year extensions may be granted subject to safeguards.
The advisory committee cited long gestation and phased development in port projects.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top market movers and stock stories

articles.title: AMD crosses $1 trillion market value for the first time
bullets: AMD shares jumped about 10% Monday to a record high.
The chipmaker topped $1 trillion in market capitalization for the first time.
Reuters said investors are betting on AMD’s expanding AI computing role.

articles.title: Meta surges as Muse AI optimism boosts tech rally
bullets: Meta shares rose 11.4% Monday after a Wells Fargo target hike tied to Muse.
The broader AI trade lifted communication services and information technology stocks.
The rally helped push the Nasdaq to a record close.

articles.title: Intel and Arm rally as semiconductor trade rebounds
bullets: Intel surged 12.2% and Arm Holdings rose 17% on Monday.
The PHLX semiconductor index jumped 4.3%.
Investors pointed to renewed confidence in AI-related spending.

articles.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. trade on merger settlement news
bullets: Paramount Skydance reached a settlement with California and 11 other states over the Warner deal.
AP said the agreement helps clear a key hurdle for the $81 billion merger.
Reuters reported Paramount shares fell nearly 3% after the settlement news.

articles.title: Novo Nordisk shares slump as investors question growth plan
bullets: Novo shares slid as much as 9% Monday, according to Reuters.
Analysts questioned pricing power and strategy ahead of patent expiries.
Management outlined more than five planned blockbuster launches by 2030.

articles.title: Paramount-Warner merger clears major legal hurdle with states’ settlement
bullets: Twelve states and Hollywood writers agreed to settle lawsuits challenging the merger.
Paramount pledged more US film production and a fund for displaced workers.
A judge still must give final approval to the settlement.

articles.title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse shopping agent from its platform
bullets: Amazon blocked Muse from browsing and buying products on Amazon.
Axios said the move came less than two weeks after Muse launched.
The dispute highlights a growing fight over AI-mediated shopping.

articles.title: Novo Nordisk pressed on post-Wegovy strategy at capital markets day
bullets: Novo executives faced tough analyst questions on pricing and dealmaking.
The company is trying to reassure markets before semaglutide patent expiries in the 2030s.
Novo said it aims to reach more than 60 million patients globally by 2030.

articles.title: Anthropic and Accenture commit $2 billion to AI model evaluation
bullets: Anthropic and Accenture each committed at least $1 billion over five years.
Accenture’s Faculty unit will red-team and evaluate Anthropic frontier models.
The partnership focuses on embedded independent evaluation of AI safeguards.

articles.title: Alibaba unveils new AI chip and bigger model plans
bullets: Alibaba introduced new AI chip technology at its Hangzhou conference.
CEO Eddie Wu called the Zhenwu V900 China’s most powerful AI chip.
The company also outlined plans for larger Qwen models and more AI computing capacity.

articles.title: Alibaba’s Zhenwu V900 intensifies China-US AI chip race
bullets: Alibaba says its new Zhenwu V900 delivers three times the performance of its prior chip.
The launch comes days before Xi Jinping’s Washington visit.
US export controls have limited China’s access to top foreign AI chips.

articles.title: US proposes AI incident notification mechanism with China
bullets: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US proposed an AI incident alert system.
The proposal emerged before Trump-Xi talks in Washington.
The mechanism would focus on incidents affecting national security.

articles.title: Agentic shopping becomes battleground after Amazon blocks Meta Muse
bullets: Amazon stopped Meta’s Muse agent from shopping on its site.
Muse had climbed to the No. 1 free app spot in major app stores, Axios reported.
Retailers face new questions over who controls AI-driven purchases.

articles.title: Anthropic and Accenture build embedded AI safety evaluation program
bullets: The partnership will give evaluators deeper access to Anthropic’s frontier models.
Accenture’s Faculty team will test safeguards and alignment.
The effort follows growing concern over advanced AI agents and model behavior.

articles.title: AMD milestone underscores renewed demand for AI computing hardware
bullets: AMD joined the $1 trillion club during Monday’s AI-led chip rally.
The company is expanding from chips into complete AI systems.
Reuters said CPU demand for inference servers has helped AMD gain share.
